[context:qualifications] rightMarginalValue is economically meaningful only at positive resources. Never use rightMarginalValue m 0 as the economic boundary marginal. The economic boundary object is zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal and may be infinite; utilityZeroRightMarginal is a distinct utility endpoint object. H06 and contract D02 use no marginal object; contract D03 and S02 use rightMarginalValue only after proving positivity. The A03 repair introduces no marginal object or boundary substitution.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean] The maintained scope is bounded, continuous, strictly increasing and strictly concave utility on nonnegative consumption, continuous resource states, and a general compact iid labor law. P03's two-point example establishes primitive consistency only, without restricting the general law or establishing optimization, stationarity or equilibrium. Unbounded log/CRRA utility and serially correlated income remain outside scope. H01–H04 retain BASIC-only premises and constructed canonical objects without impatience. H01 is a bounded-continuous Bellman self-map on unbounded NNReal with beta contraction; actual actions lie in [0,z], with shares auxiliary. H02 constructs the canonical fixed point, uniqueness among bounded continuous fixed points, uniform value iteration and global utility bounds. H03 establishes real convex-combination concavity and strict increase without derivatives. H04 constructs the unique actual shifted-asset maximizer, uses shares only at positive resources, handles zero by feasibility and proves c(z)+A(z)=z. No CoreRegularity, differentiability, invariant-law, bounded-asset or finite-state premise is added to those results.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean] P01 establishes budget and borrowing-feasibility equivalence, not No-Ponzi. Equality and feasibility are separate components; original prices satisfy R=1+r and the next-resource identity is separately proved. P02 finite-cap continuity fixes the cap and labor floor, treats r=0 separately and includes the zero-cap case without division by the cap. Its natural-cap branch requires r>0, yields -r*phi_nat=-w*l_min and effective income w*(l-l_min), and asserts no continuity of the raw natural limit through zero.

[context:qualifications] M02B's lifetime interpretation is an absolutely convergent series of expected flows under finite-history product laws, covering admitted measurable full-history feasible plans. No literal infinite-product lifetime random variable is constructed. Original-budget interpretation remains conditional on normalization from OriginalPrices, with normalized intercept=-(R-1)*phi. S05/S06 retain normalized-coordinate interpretation; A01 does not remove this qualification, and A02 explicitly requires normalization for its original-coordinate accounting identities.

[context:qualifications] H09's real inequality requires finite initial extended marginal, automatic at positive resources but conditional at zero. It establishes neither global positivity, an envelope identity at zero consumption, an Euler equation nor separate derivative continuity.

H12 alone proves no converse, borrowing threshold, universal boundary finiteness or stationary marginal-utility integrability.

dimension_assessments.summary: The new export proves continuity of the actual supply integral on ImpatientPrices m × Real, covering independent price and shift variation while preserving the original graph anchor.

Proved integrability permits S(q,phi)=meanA(q)-phi. Composition with the first projection and subtraction of the second prove joint continuity. The accepted mean proof correctly combines local common support, uniform policy convergence and weak convergence against a clipped continuous test.

Resources follow z_next=R*A(z)+fresh effective income; supply integrates shifted saving minus phi. This matches A94 equations (7)–(8). Economic debt interpretation requires phi≥0 and intercept=-(R-1)*phi; retaining phi separately handles its nonidentification at R=1.

Rendered A93 printed 39–40/PDF 40–41 supports invariant-law continuity; A94 printed 668/PDF 11, equation (8), defines supply. C90 printed 548/PDF 7, Proposition 2.4(i), states continuity without proof. The compact-support and joint-coordinate proofs are reconstructions; SLP89 is inherited through S06.

BASIC, positive-state smoothness, eventual curvature bound, essential endpoint nondegeneracy and iid law are retained. Impatience is in the price subtype; local D03 bounds are derived from convergence.

No supply continuity, invariant-law continuity or moment conclusion is assumed by the new theorem. Its premises are the admitted primitive profiles; law continuity and integrability are proved dependencies.

The diff appends one public theorem and audit entries. It preserves the graph theorem and reuses accepted M06D/M06C bodies; controller scope verification reports no unauthorized accepted-body changes.

Resources remain NNReal and labor an arbitrary probability law on a compact interval with essential endpoint neighborhoods. No finite-state, density or atom restriction appears; withPrices fixes the iid law.

The repair and mean-continuity helper use policy feasibility and ordinary asset integrals, with no boundary marginal substitution. Support includes zero without requiring positive consumption. The inherited separation of positive-state rightMarginalValue and possibly infinite zeroRightMarginal is preserved.

stationary_asset_integrable derives compact support before the integral-subtraction identity. The decomposition explicitly requires Integrable A and uses integrability of constants under a probability law. The repair performs no ENNReal.toReal conversion and obtains no economic finiteness from totalization.

Weak continuity is applied to a globally bounded continuous clipped policy. A common compact interval supports the sequence tail and limit; uniform policy convergence controls the varying integrand. This proves stationary mean continuity without claiming total variation or moments from arbitrary initial laws.
beta*R<1 is explicitly encoded in ImpatientPrices and assigned by A03. No positive-consumption, positive-minimum-income, density, mean-one labor or additional moment premise is introduced.

The appended proof uses accepted theorems and continuity operations. Both exports have assert_no_sorry coverage; controller checks report no prohibited patterns or proof shortcuts across 519 declarations.
